edges.rationale: Poor parsing and chunk boundaries directly suppress recall.
Weak recall increases packing pressure on partial evidence.
Noisy retrieval degrades packed context quality.
Noisy retrieval raises unsupported reasoning risk.
Unsupported claims often come with weak citation mapping.
Evaluator disagreement can indicate shift or judge mismatch.
Shifted traffic often first breaks evidence coverage.
Shifted domains also weaken grounding reliability.
